answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 6828 Country: India Title: I want to ask about the last hour, what are the signs mentioned in hadith that had taken place? (2) plz tell me names of some books regarding qayamat hadith &signs. (3) i have some ebooks of harun yahya on end times , are they reliable downloaded from www.harunyahya.com Question: Assalamualaikum (1) I want to ask about the last hour, what are the signs mentioned in hadith that had taken place? (2) plz tell me names of some books regarding qayamat hadith &signs. (3) i have some ebooks of harun yahya on end times , are they reliable downloaded from www.harunyahya.com Answer ID: 6828 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 701/701=M/1429) (1) The Prophet ( صلى الله عليه وسلم ) has described two signs of Doomsday in a Hadith, one sign is that slave girl will beget her mistress, i.e. at the time closer to Doomsday, children will become disobedient to their parents so much that girls who naturally obey their parents and specially love her mother, will too repudiate their parents as a master does not pay heed to the talk of a male or female slave. It means that status of parents at home will be like slaves. The second sign is that those who had no status in the society, walked with bare foot and graze goats in forest with bare body, will take glory in tall buildings i.e. the mean people will be respectable. Besides these two signs, many other signs regarding the approach of Doomsday have been described in the Hadith but these are small signs of the Doomsday. The major signs about the Doomsday, after which it will not take much time, are: (1) Hadhrat Mehdi will appear and people will do bai'ah of Khilafah on his hands before the Kaba Sharif between Rukn and Maqam (2) the one-eyed Dajjal will appear at his time and will generate tribulation, (3) Hadhrat Isa (May peace be upon him) will descend from heaven to kill Dajjal, (4) Gog and Magog (Yajooj and Majuooj) will come out, (5) The Animal (dabbatul arz) will appear form the mount 'Safa', (6) the sun will rise form the west and it will be a great sign of the Doomsday. (2) The Aahdith regarding signs of the Doomsday are mentioned in every book of Hadith under the chapter "Ashratu SaÂ’ah". Except this, there are many Urdu books as well like Alaamat-e-Qiyamat, Zuhur-e-Mehdi and so on. (3) We are neither aware of Haroon Yahya nor his books written about the Doomsday. Therefore, we are sorry to say anything about his books. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
